name: What is the difference between green board and purple board drywall?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between green board and purple board drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Green board drywall is moisture-resistant, commonly used in areas with moderate humidity like bathrooms, but it is not waterproof. Purple board drywall, often called mold and moisture-resistant, offers enhanced protection against mold, mildew, and moisture compared to green board. It's suitable for all moisture-prone areas and can offer better durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Green board is moisture-resistant, while purple board offers enhanced mold and moisture resistance, providing better protection.
